ينتجبا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِبَا (yantajibā) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# يُنْتَجَبَا (yuntajabā) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
